all.reason: Lambdas lower to shared carriers (e3e05a14b0): the translator no longer writes a class per lambda, so translating HelloCodenameOne got cheaper on both runtimes. ParparVM itself got faster (macOS, no LTO as Windows builds it: 9.36s -> 8.52s; with LTO 7.77s -> 7.09s), but JDK 25 gained more (8.66s -> 7.20s), moving the ratio. Inline vs out-of-line allocation measured identical (8.51s vs 8.53s).
